name: Happy
description: Friendly open eyes and a small cheerful open smile showing upper teeth.

name: Grin
description: A very wide clenched-tooth grin with both rows of teeth visible, smiling crescent eyes.

name: Laugh
description: Eyes squeezed shut in happy crescents, mouth open wide in hearty laughter, no tears.

name: Tears of joy
description: Eyes squeezed shut in laughter, joyful open laughing mouth, one large blue tear of laughter at each outer eye.

name: Wink
description: One eye playfully closed in a wink, other eye open, small friendly sideways smile.

name: Blush
description: Both eyes closed in smiling crescents, gentle closed-mouth smile, soft coral blush on both cheeks.

name: Angel
description: Friendly innocent open eyes and smile, one small glowing pale-blue halo floating closely above the hair.

name: Love
description: Warm affectionate closed smiling eyes, soft pleased smile, three small coral hearts nestled near the cheeks and head.

name: Heart eyes
description: Both eyes replaced by clearly recognizable coral-red heart shapes, delighted open smiling mouth.

name: Kiss
description: One eye closed in a wink, lips puckered to blow a kiss, a small coral-red heart next to the mouth.

name: Tongue out
description: Both eyes open, playful smiling mouth with a small pink tongue sticking out.

name: Zany
description: One eye wide open and slightly larger, the other squinting playfully, mouth tilted into a silly smile with the tongue out. Funny rather than disturbing.

name: Cool
description: Simple black rounded sunglasses worn over the eyes, relaxed confident closed-mouth smile.

name: Thinking
description: One eyebrow raised, eyes glancing slightly upwards, small pursed mouth, one tiny hand with thumb and index finger resting on the chin.

name: Shh
description: Eyes open with a quiet serious expression, small pursed mouth, one index finger held vertically in front of the lips.

name: Neutral
description: Relaxed level eyebrows, open expressionless eyes, a straight closed mouth. No smile or frown.

name: Smirk
description: Half-lidded eyes glancing sideways, one corner of the closed mouth raised in a confident sly smirk.

name: Sad
description: Eyes downcast and nearly closed, inner eyebrows raised sadly, small downturned closed mouth, no tears.

name: Cry
description: Sad open eyes, inner eyebrows raised, small frown, one distinct blue tear rolling down one cheek.

name: Sob
description: Both eyes squeezed shut sadly, mouth open crying, large blue tear streams down both cheeks. Clearly different from laughing with tears.

name: Angry
description: Eyebrows strongly angled down towards the nose, eyes narrowed, firm downturned closed mouth. Preserve the character's normal skin tone, no red face or flames.

name: Shock
description: Wide open surprised eyes, eyebrows raised high, mouth forming a clear round open O shape.

name: Pleading
description: Large moist puppy-dog eyes with soft highlights, inner eyebrows raised, very small soft pouting mouth. Keep original adult character proportions.

name: Sleeping
description: Both eyes peacefully shut, eyebrows relaxed, small slightly open sleeping mouth, one small pale blue sleepy bubble beside the nose. No text or Z letters.
